page.lede: P2G builds a predictive model directly from the raw sequencing reads of each sample: alignment performed after model predictions, no gene list. The analysis is performed with the same modeling, no difference between RNA or DNA, between or base-conversion or native nucleic acid sequences. No study-specific optimization. All predictions are reported on data never seen during training.

cards.tag: Reference samples · fusion RNA · Seraseq Fusion RNA Mix v3 (SRP293279)
cards.title: All 16 fusions in the reference mix are found with no model training, 9 already at a 1% spike-in, and none in 277 control samples
cards.scope: 18 libraries: the Seraseq Fusion RNA Mix v3 reference diluted into normal RNA, 3 replicate libraries at each of 6 spike-in levels, 101 to 227 million read pairs per library (median 159 million). 277 control samples with no spiked fusion: 90 plasma RNA (7.3 billion reads) and 187 tumour DNA libraries (42.2 billion reads). No stage: lab-made reference material, not patients.
keyLines: The method was not told which fusions are in the mix: It was also not told which libraries were spiked, or at what level.
Two fusions marked on the chart. KIF5B-RET and SLC45A3-BRAF are the only fusions found in all 3 replicate libraries at the 5% spike-in, and both are already found at 1%.
cards.headline: 16 of 16
sources: Seraseq Fusion RNA Mix v3 reference material

section.title: P2G finds all 16 fusions in the reference mix and predicts the tumour DNA percent of 38 held-out libraries (R² 0.93)

cards.title: P2G predicts the tumour DNA percent of 38 held-out libraries (R² 0.93)
cards.scope: 38 libraries kept out of training: 8 at 0%, 4 at 0.8%, 17 at 4% and 9 at 20% tumour DNA. Tumour DNA percent: how much of a library's DNA comes from the SEQC2 reference tumour DNA, which the study diluted into normal DNA. P2G used 5 million of a median 85 million reads per library (6%). No stage: lab-made reference material, not patients.
keyLines: Example output, automatic detection of KRAS G12A, BRAF V600E and TP53 R306* without directing P2G to these mutations

cards.title: Adverse pregnancy outcomes are told apart from uncomplicated pregnancies at AUC 0.941; the paper reports 0.91
cards.scope: Cases: preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes or chronic hypertension. Controls: pregnancies with no complication. 26 test samples (17 patients, 9 in the comparison group) from women kept out of training. P2G used 2 million of a median 32.7 million reads per sample (6.1%). Not a cancer, so there is no stage. Model: P2G v0.12 Combined method, full list.
keyLines: The paper (Del Vecchio 2021) reports AUC 0.91 for adverse outcomes from first-trimester plasma RNA, by leave-one-out cross-validation on 23 women (15 with an adverse outcome, 8 normal).

cards.scope: One dot per question. x: the paper's AUC; y: P2G held-out AUC. Questions with no published AUC sit in the left strip. Dot size: number of test samples. The next chart shows all 28 comparisons with a published AUC for the same question. Hover a dot for its tumour stage. cards.tag: Same question as the paper · reads used
cards.title: P2G is within 0.02 of the paper's AUC, or higher, for glioblastoma, breast cancer, gastric cancer, adverse pregnancy outcome and colorectal cancer, using 6% to 23% of the paper's reads
cards.scope: One dot per question with a published AUC for the same question (28 comparisons, 25 studies). x: reads P2G used per sample, as a percent of the reads the paper used (log scale). y: P2G AUC minus the paper's AUC. Each question has one P2G result here. Hover a dot for its test samples, reads and tumour stage. P2G is within 0.02 of the paper's AUC, or higher, in 7 of the 28 comparisons. Every P2G result is the P2G v0.12 Combined method, full list; the 2 questions that run did not cover (SRP618157 and SRP566788) use the earlier P2G run, Combined method, full list.
keyLines: The two dots at 100% are Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease from blood DNA (SRP722164, Pollard 2026). The paper first estimates how much of the cell-free DNA comes from each type of neuron, using the methylation of every read and a reference map of neuron methylation made outside the study. It then scores those amounts. It reports no result from the sequences alone. P2G used only the sequences, and the same reads as the paper.
sources: Reads in the paper: median reads sequenced per sample (public sequencing records)
